source.title: Disorders of compulsivity: a common bias towards learning habits

confidence_rationale: Supports MECH-080's arm-3 DV -- repeated obsolete actions after contingency change -- transdiagnostically and with structural correlates, which is a strong form of the behavioural prediction. Discounted to 0.60 because the paper's MECHANISM is a competing account rather than the claim's: control shifts OUT of the model-based planner into a model-free habit system, whereas MECH-080 wants the pathology to live as a deep basin INSIDE the rollout map. Both predict perseveration; they predict different things about whether rollout is happening at all.
failure_signatures: The perseveration is attributed to model-free habit dominance -- i.e. to forward search being BYPASSED -- not to a deep attractor within forward search; a REE agent showing arm-3 perseveration because rollout was disengaged would satisfy the DV while refuting the mechanism.

The bias was shared across OCD, binge eating disorder and methamphetamine use disorder, so perseveration after contingency change is NOT OCD-specific and cannot by itself identify the arm-3 phenotype in a three-way dissociation.

Gray matter correlates in caudate and medial orbitofrontal cortex locate the effect in a cortico-striatal habit circuit that REE's hippocampal rollout map does not model, so the substrate claim in MECH-080 has no anatomical support here.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Across three disorders of compulsivity -- obsessive-compulsive disorder, binge eating disorder and methamphetamine use disorder -- subjects showed a common shift toward model-free (habitual) rather than model-based (goal-directed) control on a two-step sequential decision task, and the degree of habit bias correlated with lower gray matter volume in caudate and medial orbitofrontal cortex.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports the behavioural dependent variable MECH-080 nominates for arm 3: action selection that persists after the contingency it was built for has changed. In REE the corresponding measurement already has an instrument -- world_rule_shift_enabled applies action-pair transpositions and emits steps_since_world_rule_shift -- so perseveration-after-shift is scoreable even though the rest of arm 3 is substrate-blocked.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The mechanism is a rival, not a confirmation. MECH-080 posits an abnormally deep basin within the hippocampal rollout map such that normal signals cannot trigger basin exit -- pathology INSIDE forward search. Voon et al. describe control being ceded to a habit system that does not forward-search at all -- pathology consisting of forward search being ABSENT. The two are behaviourally convergent and architecturally opposite, and a REE experiment scoring only the DV cannot tell them apart. Any arm-3 design must add a measurement of whether rollout is still running.
mapping.source_context: Adult clinical samples across three compulsivity diagnoses plus controls; two-step model-based/model-free decision task; structural MRI gray-matter correlation.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality 0.80: Molecular Psychiatry, a strong transdiagnostic design with convergent structural imaging and an author list that is most of the field. Mapping fidelity 0.50 is the binding discount and reflects the rival-mechanism problem, not a weakness in the paper. Transfer risk 0.45 -- adult clinical populations and a cortico-striatal circuit to a hippocampal rollout parameter is a long step.
